# DCU Live

> DCU Live is a free app that shows a Dublin City University (DCU) student their own timetable (their programme, groups and labs) along with assignment deadlines and cancelled classes shared by classmates. It runs in the browser at https://app.dculive.ie/ and needs a DCU email address (@mail.dcu.ie or @dcu.ie) to sign in. It is a student project with some support from DCU, but it is not an official DCU app and is not recognised or endorsed by Dublin City University.

## What it does

- Personal timetable: pick your programme, groups and labs and see only your classes, in a day view with the free time between classes or a week grid.
- Deadlines: students add assignment deadlines for their modules and classmates confirm them, so each deadline shows how many people have vouched for the date.
- Cancelled classes: when a lecture is off, someone in the class reports it and it shows as cancelled on everyone's timetable.
- Light and dark themes that follow the device.

## Where it runs

- Web app, on any phone or computer, with nothing to install: https://app.dculive.ie/
- iPhone and Android: add the web app to the Home Screen (Safari: Share, then Add to Home Screen; Chrome: the ⋮ menu, then Add to Home screen or Install app).
- Mac app, for macOS 14 or later, with the week view, deadlines and class alerts as Mac notifications: https://dculive.ie/#get
